# cksum

Compute and verify checksums for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/cksum@0.1.6 [OPTION]... [FILE]...
```

## Supported scope

Process files or stdin. Default is POSIX CRC-32 plus byte count. Algorithms: bsd, sysv, crc, crc32b, md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha2, sha3, blake2b and sm3. Modern digests support tagged/untagged records and verification.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-a` / `--algorithm` | required | Select the checksum algorithm listed above. |
| `-l` / `--length` | required | SHA2/SHA3: 224, 256, 384, 512; BLAKE2b: 8..512 by 8 |
| `--untagged` | none | omit algorithm tags (modern digests default to tags) |
| `--base64` | none | encode modern digests in Base64 |
| `--raw` | none | write digest bytes without names or separators |
| `-b` / `--binary` | none | mark untagged output as binary |
| `-t` / `--text` | none | mark untagged output as text (default) |
| `--tag` | none | print BSD tagged records |
| `-c` / `--check` | none | read checksum records and verify files |
| `-z` / `--zero` | none | end output records with NUL; disable escaping |
| `--ignore-missing` | none | skip missing files when checking |
| `--quiet` | none | suppress successful verification output |
| `--status` | none | suppress verification results and summaries |
| `--strict` | none | fail if a checksum line is malformed |
| `-w` / `--warn` | none | warn for each malformed checksum line |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Legacy checksum formats cannot be verified with --check.
- Binary/text flags change record markers, not input bytes. --raw accepts one input and conflicts with --base64.
- Check mode rejects explicit --tag, -b/-t and -z; at least one digest must match even with --ignore-missing.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/cksum@0.1.6 input.bin
moonx cli/cksum@0.1.6 -a sha256 input.bin
```
